data.body: Plan-review remediation applied. The save contract is now sidecar-first: set_last_get stages an inline failure floor, save promotes chronological max to get_rotation.json, and only a successful sidecar persist permits inline scrub. A fail-open sidecar write retains the inline floor; a crash after sidecar replace is also safe because the max is already durable. Added explicit failure/crash integration oracles and scoped rollback support to A2-1-or-newer binaries; pre-A2-1 rollback loses only bounded rotation optimization and is prohibited after the deployment gate. Re-review required before claim.
